summary: Bug fix verification complete for DESPIECE library filters. All library positions (horizontal, vertical, top) now correctly show DESPIECE filters (FABRICANTE, MODELO, ACABADO, GROSOR) when in COCINA DESPIECE mode, and MONTADA filters (PROGRAMA, CATEGORÍA, SERIE) when in COCINA MONTADA mode.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIX VERIFIED: Vertical library (right sidebar) now shows correct DESPIECE filters (FABRICANTE, MODELO, ACABADO, GROSOR) in DESPIECE mode
BUG FIX VERIFIED: Vertical library shows correct MONTADA filters (PROGRAMA, CATEGORÍA, SERIE) in MONTADA mode
BUG FIX VERIFIED: Horizontal library (bottom) shows correct filters based on active module
BUG FIX VERIFIED: Top library shows correct filters based on active module
BUG FIX VERIFIED: Left sidebar shows 'MATERIAL DESPIECE' section with DESPIECE filters in DESPIECE mode
BUG FIX VERIFIED: Left sidebar shows 'GRUPO DE PRECIOS' section in MONTADA mode
Code review: The conditional rendering at line 2827 correctly checks state.currentModule === 'despiece' to show appropriate filters
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for DESPIECE library filters has been verified. The vertical library (right sidebar) now correctly shows DESPIECE-specific filters (FABRICANTE, MODELO, ACABADO, GROSOR) when in COCINA DESPIECE mode instead of incorrectly showing MONTADA filters (PROGRAMA, CATEGORÍA, SERIE). All three library positions (horizontal, vertical, top) have been tested and work correctly.

module_switching.details: Switching between COCINA MONTADA and COCINA DESPIECE correctly updates all library filters

bug_verification.original_issue: Vertical library (right sidebar) in DESPIECE mode was incorrectly showing MONTADA filters (PROGRAMA/CATEGORÍA/SERIE) instead of DESPIECE filters (FABRICANTE/MODELO/ACABADO/GROSOR)
bug_verification.fix_description: Added conditional rendering based on state.currentModule === 'despiece' to show appropriate filter sets
bug_verification.verification_result: FIXED - All library positions now correctly display module-specific filters
